purpose: Prepared landscape studies for the open Dream Drift experiment; browser-time variations use local Inception DeepDream, not a live image-generation API.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: immersive panoramic environment texture for an experimental image-based dream dome. Input image 1 is a subject, terrain and palette reference, not an edit target. Create a single wide 2:1 panoramic landscape of a surreal Himalayan valley transformed by the marmot photograph: tawny fur-like geological terraces, softly rounded marmot-silhouette rock formations far away, pale stone, saturated turquoise glacial pools and luminous coral-magenta mineral seams. Ground-level eye-height, open uninterrupted terrain, distant broad mountains, level horizon near the vertical center, richly textured foreground below and airy cobalt-violet sky above. Cyberspace dream atmosphere, uncanny and playful, clean and luminous with little empty black, not scary. Surreal landscape photography mixed with organic neural patterns, NOT a video game screenshot, no paths or doors or arches, no UI, no letters, no printed hex/ASCII (the application adds these). No large foreground animal, people or logos. Make the left and right edges closely match in color, horizon and terrain for wrapping; avoid major focal objects at edges. Preserve gold/ochre color and mountain forms from the reference while making a new environment.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one wide 2:1 immersive panoramic landscape texture for a surreal neon dream dome. Reference image is subject/terrain/color inspiration, not an edit target. Invent an open Himalayan wetland at violet-blue twilight: a calm turquoise reflective plain with delicate luminous coral, amber and lilac vegetation whose fuzzy organic forms subtly echo marmot fur. Far away round ochre hills have almost-animal silhouettes, while hovering mirrored mountain fragments produce an impossible double horizon. Eye-level level horizon at vertical center, ground and pools filling the lower half, glowing cobalt and lavender atmospheric sky in upper half. Highly saturated but clean, uncanny, curious and peaceful, textured photographic terrain with an artificial neural dream quality. No human structures, paths, arches, characters, giant foreground animal, text, ASCII, UI or logos. Rich colored shadows, little empty black. Left and right edges closely match horizon and palette for wrapping. Make it visibly distinct from a desert valley: more water, luminous vegetation, hanging terrain.

Use case: stylized-concept. One wide 2:1 panoramic environment texture, surreal image-conditioned Himalayan dream landscape. Reference photo provides ochre marmot fur, rounded shapes and bare mountain terrain, not a target for literal editing. Create an impossible geological plain whose distant mountain ridges curl into enormous smooth nested folds and suspended loops, like the image itself has gently folded into three dimensions. Honey-gold fuzzy mineral terraces merge with translucent turquoise stone and bright pink-lilac veins. Subtle almost-marmot shapes in distant hills, no giant foreground animal. Open broad terrain, small reflective pools, photographic tactile surface detail mixed with neural organic patterns. Saturated cobalt-violet sky with fine luminous cloud filaments. Warm, clean, cyber-surreal, curious and playful, little empty black, no scary faces. Ground-level viewpoint, level central horizon, sky upper half and detailed ground lower half, no corridor or designated path, no doors or constructed arches, no UI, letters, ASCII or watermark. Similar left/right horizon and colors for wraparound. Distinct feature: folded mountains and translucent geological loops, rather than an ordinary valley.
